spn-legal-runtime.purpose: Parent and child flow ownership and run ledger

spn-legal-reader.purpose: Read approved source systems and create restricted ingest rows

spn-legal-analyzer.purpose: Read ingest rows and create bounded analysis records

spn-legal-writer.purpose: Create drafts, outputs, state, and audit from approved analysis

spn-legal-delivery.purpose: Deliver an exact approved artifact to an approved destination

rules: Separate connection references are not isolation when they bind to the same credential.
Flow ownership reassignment is a post-import tenant operation.
Connector support for service principals must be verified individually.
Co-owners and environment administrators remain privileged; managed solutions are defense in depth.
